definitions.explanation: A person on a journey, especially one who travels on foot or undertakes a long, meaningful journey. More literary and evocative than the modern 旅行者, suggesting a solitary or contemplative traveler.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}の{旅人|たびびと}が{村|むら}にやって{来|き}た。
examples.english: A lone traveler came to the village.

examples.japanese: {旅人|たびびと}は{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}い、{山小屋|やまごや}で{一夜|いちや}を{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: The traveler got lost and spent the night in a mountain hut.

examples.japanese: {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}は{自|みずか}らを{旅人|たびびと}と{呼|よ}び、{各地|かくち}を{巡|めぐ}って{俳句|はいく}を{詠|よ}んだ。
examples.english: Matsuo Basho called himself a traveler and composed haiku as he journeyed across the land.

notes:
USAGE:
{旅人|たびびと} has a literary and poetic quality, evoking the image of a wanderer on foot. It appears frequently in folktales, classical literature, and historical narratives. {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}'s famous opening of {奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち} — "{月日|つきひ}は{百代|はくたい}の{過客|かかく}にして" — reflects this tradition of the poet as traveler.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {孤独|こどく}な{旅人|たびびと}: a solitary traveler
- {旅人|たびびと}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome a traveler
- {旅人|たびびと}の{姿|すがた}: the figure of a traveler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅行者|りょこうしゃ}: tourist, traveler (modern, neutral)
- {旅人|たびびと}: traveler, wanderer (literary, evocative)
- {放浪者|ほうろうしゃ}: vagabond, drifter (aimless wandering)
